meta.name: audit-content
meta.description: Comprehensive content quality and maintenance assessment. Evaluates documentation quality, relevance, maintenance needs, and provides actionable recommendations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估文档质量并给出改进建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定期检查文档质量并获取优化建议。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate documentation quality and provide improvement suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to regularly assess documentation quality and get actionable recommendations.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以扫描指定的文档或内容文件夹，检查内容是否过时、质量如何、有无错误，并生成一份包含质量评分、问题列表和修复建议的报告。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 审计某个文件或文件夹的内容时触发。

say.text: 审计 /workspace/docs 文件夹的内容质量
say.note: Claude 会扫描文件夹并生成报告。

say.text: 检查最近六个月没更新的文档
帮我找出文件中有死链接的地方

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can scan specified documents or content folders, check freshness, quality, and errors, then generate a report with quality scores, issue lists, and fix suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to audit a file or folder's content.

say_en.text: Audit the content quality of /workspace/docs folder.
say_en.note: Claude scans the folder and generates a report.

say_en.text: Check for documents not updated in the last six months.
Find broken links in my files.
say_en.note: Claude detects dead links and reports them.
